construct: Pathogenic variants affecting the ENaC PY motif impair binding of the Nedd4-2 ubiquitin ligase and reduce channel ubiquitination/removal from the apical membrane, increasing ENaC abundance and distal sodium reabsorption. Volume expansion suppresses renin and aldosterone while potassium and hydrogen ion losses cause hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Early familial hypertension with hypokalemic alkalosis and suppressed renin/aldosterone is Liddle syndrome; impaired Nedd4-2 interaction prevents normal ENaC ubiquitination/removal.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Apparent mineralocorticoid excess is a strong low-renin/low-aldosterone alternative, but it is caused by 11β-HSD2 loss rather than impaired ENaC degradation. Gitelman and Bartter cause salt wasting with renin/aldosterone activation; primary aldosteronism has elevated aldosterone.
